title: Thumb-rule block for excess sludge production and volume
latex: \begin{aligned}\mathrm{Excess\ sludge} &= (A/(0.6\ \mathrm{to}\ 0.8)) + B\\ A &= Q\times Y_{obs}(S_0-S)\\ Y_{obs} &= Y/(1+K_d\times\theta_c)\\ B &= Q\times \mathrm{inert\ TSS\ removal}\\ \mathrm{Inert\ TSS} &= \mathrm{Influent\ TSS} - \mathrm{Influent\ VSS}\\ \mathrm{Excess\ sludge\ in\ kg/day} &= Y_{obs}\times \mathrm{BOD\ inlet}\times \mathrm{Flow\ MLD}\\ \mathrm{Excess\ sludge\ volume\ m^3/day} &= (\mathrm{Excess\ wasted\ kg/day})\times 1000/\mathrm{MLSS\ in\ clarifier\ underflow}\end{aligned}
readable: Excess sludge = (A/(0.6 to 0.8)) + B;  A = Q × Yobs (S0-S);  Yobs = Y/(1+Kd × θc);  where Y is 0.5;  Kd is 0.06;  B = Q × inert TSS removal;  Inert TSS = Influent TSS − Influent VSS;  Excess sludge in kg/day = Yobs × BOD inlet × Flow MLD;  Excess sludge volume m3/day = (Excess wasted kg/day) × 1000/MLSS in clarifier underflow

symbols.definition: calculated by the equation A = Q×Yobs (S0-S)
is from Figure 5-38 for the lowest operating temperature
0.6 to be used for extended aeration and 0.8 is used for conventional activated sludge

applicability: Design thumb rules for excess sludge wasting: the printed text selects the higher of the two computed excess sludge values, then converts to volume using the MLSS in the clarifier underflow, usually 3 times the MLSS.
notes: Unnumbered block; Ep378-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.

The formulas are interleaved with printed prose lines that are not formulas: "A is calculated by the following equation and 0.6 to be used for extended aeration and 0.8 is used for conventional activated sludge.", "Where Y is 0.5", "Kd is 0.06", "TSS removal in primary settling tank is 60%.", "Inert SS removal in primary settling tank is 60%.", "VSS removal in primary settling tank is 60%.", "θc is from Figure 5-38 for the lowest operating temperature.", "Calculate excess sludge kg/day from the thumb rule in Section 5.8.1.7.5.10", "Adopt the higher value", "MLSS in clarifier underflow is to be assumed based on the SWD and is usually 3 times the MLSS."

The printed page repeats the expression "Excess sludge" for two different quantities (kg/day and m³/day) and prints "inert/Inert" and "Influent" with inconsistent capitalisation; preserved as printed.
